title: Warden MoveOrbit/Wander clamps to screen size instead of map size
detail: MoveOrbit() and Wander() in state.go clamp warden position to hardcoded (0,1200) for X and (0,540) for Y. Map_01 is 1320x600, meaning the warden can never reach the rightmost 120px or bottommost 60px of the map even if the cluster center moves there. All 4 sessions report this anomaly at tick 601.

suggested_fix.description: Replace the 4 hardcoded clamp values in MoveOrbit (lines 135-136, 153-154) and Wander (lines 185-186) with WardenState fields MapWidth/MapHeight. Add MapWidth float64 and MapHeight float64 fields to WardenState, set them when creating the warden (from gamemap.PixelWidth()/PixelHeight()). Change all 6 occurrences of clampF(..., 0, 1200) to clampF(..., 0, s.MapWidth) and clampF(..., 0, 540) to clampF(..., 0, s.MapHeight). Also update the Wander random target generation (line ~170) to use s.MapWidth/s.MapHeight instead of 1200/540.
